reason: I have one, maybe two chairs and I cut most of the hair myself, so I already know who sat where and I count the drawer every night. ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is a fixed cost that doesn't care about my slow months, and nobody I know is using it yet.
objection: ₹999 a month is one more fixed cost, and some months are slow. For a shop my size the staff tracking and drawer checks don't save me anything I don't already do with my own eyes.
would_change_my_mind: If another small salon owner near me was using it and showed me the WhatsApp reminders actually brought customers back enough to cover the monthly fee.
